summary: Two small forms on the crews page: one creates a new crew from a name, the other joins a crew with a six-letter code.
purpose: Lets fans start or join a crew from the crews page.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond placing the two actions side by side.
how: 1) Each form sends its data to the matching route. 2) On success it opens the new crew page. 3) On failure it shows the message from the server.
inputs: A crew name for the first form. A six-letter invite code for the second form.
outputs: A redirect to the crew page, or an error message.
risks: Success is decided by whether the response contains an id, so a route that succeeds without returning an id would look like a failure.
debug: If a form shows an error, check the message from the server and the route it calls.
